title: SMProfile-CustomerOrder payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.json 3.0.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

quantity.description: Ordered piece count of the order line (menge). Together with unit_price the source for total_amount — the real ERP does not keep an order total: order value = quantity × unit_price (derived by the it-evaluator).

unit_price.description: Unit price of the order line (stueckpreis). Together with quantity the source for total_amount (= quantity × unit_price).

total_amount.description: Order value. Delivered directly where available; otherwise derived by the it-evaluator as quantity × unit_price (the real ERP has no total column). Driver of the €-impact prioritization (expected_impact).

due_date.description: Customer delivery commitment (the promised date the sales order is due).

status.description: Sales-order status, as it reaches THIS profile through OUR source binding. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/customer-order.md, attributes › status › description.

customer_due_date.description: Customer delivery date of the order (moved here from ProductionOrder in core 3.0.0).
